purpose: Test fixture for Arabic-script runs in verbatim quotes (DESIGN.md 5.1; tests/unit/script-runs.test.ts). Not curated content and never imported. The quote is the Wikipedia passage on the word Ajrak that the ajrakh etymology claim cited until content round 2 dropped it (an unverified-kind source); it is kept here only as a string with real Sindhi and Persian runs, so the right-to-left rendering stays covered whatever content/ holds.

quotes.quote: The word Ajrak ( Sindhi : اجرڪ ) derives from the Persian word ajar ( Persian : اجر ), meaning "brick," combined with the diminutive suffix -ak ( Persian : ک ), meaning "small," conveying a sense of unity and reflecting the craft's cultural journey
